name: wide_hand_prefilter
description: boss-ai C4 / C6 pre-filter: default band 2 with budgets.max_evals_per_action lowered to 10 (the Tuning Knobs minimum). The player has three 1/2s; the boss has two awake 1/3 attackers and a hand of one aoe spell (damage 1 to all_enemy_minions: op_value 1.0 x 3 targets), three 2-damage single-target spells (4 legal targets each) and two vanilla 2/2s. After position filtering that is 24 candidates (1 + 12 + 2 + 8 attacks + end_turn), more than 10. No card here has a discover or choose_one op.
